# PageTemplateElements

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The elements an element-based page template chooses among; see `FromElements`.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Implements `IEquatable<PageTemplateElements>`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new PageTemplateElements(IElement Default = null, IElement FirstPage = null, IElement Odd = null, IElement Even = null)
```

## Properties

- [`Default`](#default): Used on every page no more specific member covers.
- [`Even`](#even): Used on even pages (2, 4, 6, …).
- [`FirstPage`](#firstpage): Used on page 1 only.
- [`Odd`](#odd): Used on odd pages (1, 3, 5, …) that `FirstPage` does not cover.
